# Karim Khamis — AI Automation Engineer & Full-Stack Developer

> AI automation engineer and full-stack developer based in Cairo, Egypt. Builds production LLM applications (RAG with citations, LangGraph agents, human-in-the-loop n8n workflows) plus web and mobile apps with Next.js, React, Django, and React Native. Available for freelance projects and full-time roles worldwide.

## About

Karim Khamis is an AI automation engineer and full-stack software developer with 3+ years of freelance experience (30+ projects, 100% on-time delivery). He holds a B.Sc. in Software Engineering from Ain Shams University (2022, GPA 3.2/4.0) and is pursuing an M.Sc. in Computer Engineering at AASTMT (expected 2028), with research focused on OCR and multilingual document processing.

He completed an internship as a Full-Stack Developer at The Address Company (Jan–Jun 2025), works as a Graduate Researcher in OCR at AASTMT (Jul 2025–present), and in 2026 built and deployed AI Lab, a production-style AI automation platform.

## Skills

- AI automation / LLM apps: Groq and OpenAI-compatible APIs, RAG (embeddings, Top-K retrieval, citations, refusal), LangGraph and LangChain agents (tool calling, thread memory), n8n workflow orchestration, human-in-the-loop approval queues, structured output with Zod, model routing (fast/strong), Redis/Upstash caching, usage and cost tracking, LLM guardrails (prompt injection, blocked topics, token limits), MCP awareness
- Languages: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Arabic (native), English (advanced), French (intermediate)
- Frontend: React, Next.js, React Native, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Expo/EAS
- Backend: Next.js API routes, Django, Django REST Framework, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Redis
- AI/ML research: TensorFlow, Keras, PaddleOCR, OpenCV, NumPy
- DevOps: Docker, Vercel, Render, Hetzner, Cloudinary
- Other: Git, MongoDB, JWT authentication

## Flagship Projects

### AI Lab — AI Automation Platform (live)
https://ai-lab-alpha-five.vercel.app — Production-style AI automation platform built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, and the Groq LLM API. Features: PDF RAG with local embeddings, citations, and refusal when context is weak; a LangGraph research agent with tool calling, thread memory, and visible steps; an editable human-in-the-loop approval queue for AI-drafted emails (Gmail); four n8n webhook workflows (support ticket, CRM lead extraction, email automation, meeting summary) with idempotency keys and run logs; API-key auth, per-IP rate limiting, Redis answer cache, fast/strong model routing, usage and cost dashboard, and prompt-injection guardrails. Deployed 24/7 on Vercel.

### Letra — Cross-Platform OCR Mobile App
Custom-trained OCR application for iOS and Android built with React Native (Expo), TensorFlow/Keras, and PaddleOCR. Achieves 98% English character recognition accuracy. Deployed to TestFlight and Google Play Beta.

### Qodrateman — E-Learning Platform
Full-stack e-learning platform at qodrateman.com. Built with React, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, and JWT authentication. Features 12+ courses and AI-powered quiz generation in under 30 seconds.
